updates.content:
Title: Some users may be unable to view organization information in multiple Microsoft 365 services

User impact: Users may be unable to view organization information in multiple Microsoft 365 services.

More info: Affected users may find that Organization Explorer appears empty or doesn't display the expected organizational information in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop client and Outlook on the web.

Current status: We’ve determined that the underlying organization data appears correct, but some requests are returning incorrect user information that can prevent Organization Explorer from displaying content. We’re investigating the process responsible for refreshing cached information, which may be causing incorrect user information to be stored and returned, while assessing a change to how these responses are handled as we work to isolate the source of the incorrect updates and determine the appropriate remediation. 

Scope of impact: This issue may affect some users who are attempting to view organization information in multiple Microsoft 365 services are impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation progresses.

Next update by: Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 12:30 AM UTC

Title: Some users may be unable to view organization information in multiple Microsoft 365 services

User impact: Users may be unable to view organization information in multiple Microsoft 365 services

More info: Affected users may find that Organization Explorer appears empty or doesn't display the expected organizational information in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop client and Outlook on the web.

Current status: We've isolated the source of this issue to the process that refreshes cached user data. After this process runs, user data, including organizational information, isn't returned correctly. We're comparing nine possible code paths that handle the cache refresh process to identify which one is causing organization information to display incorrectly. 

Scope of impact: This issue may affect some users who are attempting to view organization information in multiple Microsoft 365 services are impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation progresses.

Root cause: The process that refreshes cached user data causes the data to not be returned as expected, resulting in an incorrect evaluation of the user's organizational relationship. 

Next update by: Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 12:30 AM UTC
